verdict.rationale: Manufact documents a few fixed event-driven automations: pushing to the production branch triggers a deployment, a publish checklist can start automatically after each successful deployment, and a 'Deployment paths & triggers' settings section exists. These are preset toggles, not a user-defined rules engine. Missing for 10: general user-authored rule definitions (arbitrary event → action mapping), broader event sources such as observability or gateway events, conditional logic, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Pushing to your production branch triggers a deployment automatically
you can start a checklist automatically after each successful deployment
Set which Git branch serves your canonical production URL from the Deployment paths & triggers section
